items.title: Heroicis
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Get epic with the latest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! You awaken to the sound of creaking wood and the rolling pitch of a ship. There's no sign of anyone else around you, but an epic city stands on the shores before you. Similarly devoid of inhabitants, will you brave the challenges within to bring safety back to its halls? Prove yourself...

items.title: Ninjas Secret Base
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description: On this Japanese temple, the ninjas of the past left an incredible underground base hidden and protected for generations! Come and explore this incredible ninjas secret base!

items.title: DRAGON SLAYERS
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
The DRAGON SLAYERS have entered the battle! Are you ready to slay the dragon? Enter the castle and defeat any dragon in your path with the heroic the DRAGON SLAYERS!

- Epic
- Medieval 
- DRAGON SLAYER skin pack
- Perfect for castle role-playing
- Fantasy

DRAGON SLAYERS by: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Viking Village
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Conquer the arctic and rule a Viking village! Roleplay in the city and live your life a Viking!

+ Viking city home!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Craftable Dragons
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
The last dragon is gone, craft new ones to ride! You are a beast tamer, gifted with the knowledge of crafting dragon eggs. Raise the hatchlings into adults with special abilities, such as gliding, fire-breathing, and more.
- 8 unique dragons with special abilities
- 3 colors and camouflage for each dragon
- 5 skins

Play in English, German, French, and more!

items.title: Cute Galaxy Fashion
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Just like the stars in the sky, shine bright and be one of a kind. Choose between 12 modern outfits that are perfect for showcasing your love for space while looking trendy! 

- 12 out of this world teens

items.title: Bed Wars Blitz
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Bed Wars Blitz is a challenging battle of strategy, speed, and skill! Collect resources, protect your bed, gear up, and set out to defeat your enemies. Enjoy classic, fast-paced bed wars game play with an innovative upgrade system for super extra fun!

Play PVP with up to 16 friends!
Play alone or with a team vs powerful AI opponents!
10 themed maps inside
8 HD skins!

items.title: Super Gamers
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Gear up for serious gaming. Be the ace, expert, best gamer around when you role-play in these super skins. With a pro microphone and headset, show everyone who the master gamer is. Choose from lots of options with lots of skill and style. Take control and do what you do best: Win!

+ 8 super HD skins

items.title: Cute Demons
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Be just a little naughty while looking super nice! Make some mischief and plenty of funny business in Cute Demons skins. Role-play with friends as adorable spirits in pretty pinks and radiant reds. Looking like not-so-innocent cupids with wings and horns, try some harmless tricks. And get into some adorable trouble along the way!

+ 8 darling devil HD skins

items.title: Andromeda Horror
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Strike terror and fear all over Minecraft in awful Andromeda Horror skins. Worse than anyone’s imagination, role-play with friends as mad and monstrous creatures. Gear up in big, black, eyes and green skin to become a weird alien. With one big, creepy eye right in the middle of your face, scare the whole city. Be freaky and frightening all at once!

+ 8 odd, eerie HD skins

items.title: ECO Modern Base
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Welcome to the Eco Modern Base! Place who love nature and this cube world, away from the cities and the noise you will get your secret base with everything to start your new adventure! 

+ Secret base in forest
+ 5 vegetables skins for role-play
+ Support for multiplayer with friends
+ By In Mine

items.title: Crazy Cartoon Monsters
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
You like to blow up other houses with TNT? Running everywhere and killing everybody on non PvP maps and stealing their furnitures? Use these skins as crazy as you are to mess with your gamer friends!

- 25 absolutely crazy skins
+ 2 free skins!
- 5 colors variations
- By Pixelusion & Golimane

items.title: Modern Mansion
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Modern Mansion is a big mansion equipped with everything a millionaire needs! A cinema, pools, many bedrooms, 3 luxury cars and much more. You can explore the luxury mansion alone or with friends.

+ Huge mansion with interior
+ 3 supercars

items.title: Advanced Palace
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Advanced Palace is a beautiful castle ready for you and your friends to explore and play with. Find all hidden knights in the castle to open the secret treasure chamber.

- Castle
- 6 skins
- Roleplay 
- 17 knights

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Warlocks and Witches
items.creator: House of How
items.description: It’s a cloudless night and the moon is right, your coven arrives and candles are lit. Each ritual is different, each spirit unique, but you’ve found a balance between conjuring and enchantment. What will you see when you pull the tarot card? Will you risk the ouija board, or rely on your innate psychic connection? Tap into the occult with these 10 spell binding skins!

items.title: Skyblock Nether Dungeons
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
The skyblock that you love, but then with dungeons and a giant nether adventure. Explore the custom islands in the nether to find loot and gear that you can use to build out your skyblock.

- Loot the dungeons for items and gear
- Explore mysterious islands in the nether
- Multiplayer friendly

items.title: Oldschool Skins
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
What era are we in? Did we just go back to the fifties?! Far out!
Grab one of these characters, jump into a ’57 Chevy Nomad, and go for a cruise.
There’s fifteen fantastic skins to choose from, so take a look!

items.title: Glitch Mobs Squads HD
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Code defects have banded together in a quadrangle of quintessential quirks: color coded critters! Cerulean slimes and drowned, green guardians and magenta magma, crimson cows and zombies, each with a glitchy squad to back it up! This digital deluxe pack has 
8 mechanized mobs in 
4 crazy colors for a total of
32 spectacular skins!

items.title: Froggy Tears
items.creator: House of How
items.description: This ain't no pity party! It's a pastel rainbow froggy party! These tears of joy were created to fill your life with fun and excitement. A pool of vibrant stripes, an iridescent splash, smooth plaids, and glittering hues. Go ahead, brighten your day, and dance a little with these 11 colorful skins!

items.title: Purge Squads
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
The pastry wars are upon us!
We all knew it would come to this. For too long, tensions have risen between the blueberries and the raspberries. Conflict has always been brewing between the strawberries and the lemons.
Now is the time for battle. There are twenty-eight skins to pick from! Choose your side!

items.title: City Squads
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
There’s a rumble downtown, and you’re invited!
These characters have staked out different territories in the city, and they need your help to defend their turf!
Check out these character teams - twenty four skins in all!

items.title: Hoodie Gang 2
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
The gang has grown a bit now, with these 6 awesome skins! No matter the time of the year, stay fresh and cozy with these all-new skins of trendsetters wearing a variety of hoodies. Show off your style!

- Includes 6 cool and cozy hoodie skins
- Patterns, colors, and comfort for everyone
- By Smiley Team & Pathway Studios

items.title: Animal Cuties
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Mimic your favorite furry friends with this incredibly detailed skin pack of some lovable animals. Start your own animal kingdom with your friends or live among your four-legged brethren on the plains, mountains, or jungles.

- Includes 15 HD skins!
- Animal lovers are bound to find their perfect match
- By PixelPoly Digital & Pathway Studios

items.title: The Pusky Village
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Two years ago, a catastrophe wiped out 99% of living beings. A group of survivors traveled to each corner of the planet until they found a magical tree. Recently, some monsters leftover from the catastrophe invaded and poisoned the tree.

- Destroy 20 spawners and bring peace back to the village!
- Fight the final blaze boss!
- By Varuna & Pathway Studios
